name: @report/desktop
description: Electron + React desktop client. Builds to a Windows .exe installer.
author: Medical Company <reports@example.com>

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web

comments: There are intentionally NO runtime `dependencies`: electron-vite bundles the
renderer (React, Mantine, ...) with Vite, and the main/preload processes only
use `electron` + Node builtins. Keeping `dependencies` empty stops electron-builder
from trying to (re)install node_modules at package time, which breaks in an npm
workspaces monorepo. Everything below is a devDependency on purpose.
